item.title: Rebirth of the Excellent Daughter of the Marquis Household (REDMH) — Chapter 250
item.description: “Alright, alright, I know. I’m not forcing you to open your heart right now. Just stay by my side properly and don’t get into any trouble, is that okay?” Yun Ke was left speechless for quite some time by Gu Yu Qi’s words, and could only say this, “These are critical times. I’m afraid something…
